scope: Narrow whole-parent-directory no-follow I/O delta and its callers. Actual Git source read, exact text differencing and byte/hash/tree calculations only.

examined_changes.name: retained directory spine
examined_changes.finding: All three scripts use the same _directory_identity/_checked_parent/_read_extent text. The absolute path has a root anchor and excludes '..'. Each intermediate component is opened relative to a retained descriptor with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC. Every parent/name-to-child association and held child descriptor is checked by device/inode/mode/uid/gid before and after the successful leaf operation. All retained descriptors are closed in finally.

examined_changes.name: regular reads
examined_changes.finding: Leaf reads use the checked parent fd with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC. A regular file and the applicable owner/link/size profile are admitted before reading. The leaf name and descriptor identities, including nlink/size/mtime/ctime, are checked before and after the exact declared extent. Short reads refuse; no extra EOF byte is consumed. Tool binaries retain their separate owner/link admission.

examined_changes.name: exclusive output writes
examined_changes.finding: The controller and authoring helper blocks are exactly equal. Creation uses O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC relative to the retained parent, fchmod to the chosen original mode, a complete write loop, fsync, identity checks, lseek, and a full same-descriptor readback. The name-to-inode association and parent chain are rechecked. The controller additionally performs its original separately admitted readback.

examined_changes.name: private directory creation
examined_changes.finding: The new root/control/guard and authoring evidence/native directories use relative mkdir under the retained parent, then O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW open. Owner, private permission bits and leaf identity are checked. Existing directories are not accepted or modified.

examined_changes.name: diagnostic reservation
examined_changes.finding: The existing raw-size omission and aggregate reservation now occur after fixed parent/leaf descriptor admission. A bounded read reserves the admitted size before reading; failed reads remain explicitly erroneous and do not create successful frames. The original 17 fixed paths, 4 MiB raw ceiling and closed-owner gate remain unchanged.

examined_changes.name: actual execution path scope
examined_changes.finding: The controller verifies original and installed root/control files through the new reader before its existing execve into the unchanged guardian. The authoring process reads its inputs through the same spine. Diagnostics does not open root/control itself; its fixed actual reads now all use the read-only spine. This is an I/O observation and identity check, not an atomic lock or open-fd execution guarantee across child launch.

delta_restrictions.authoring: Only the new IO helpers/import, create/regular/signature, and two mkdir call sites change. Signature adds uid/gid; all source execution, bootstrap, compilation and native-case code is otherwise identical.
delta_restrictions.controller: Only the new IO helpers/import, read/create, three mkdir call sites, and r2-to-r3 control prefix/runtime root change.
delta_restrictions.diagnostics: Only the new IO helpers/import, optional require message, descriptor-bound read/reservation, and r2-to-r3 prefix/runtime root change.
delta_restrictions.policy: Three changed script hashes, control prefix and explicit unexecuted control_IO declaration. All original product/budget fields are equal.
delta_restrictions.workflow_template: Only reviewed prefix/root/policy hash substitutions and truthful display/artifact titles. CONTROL_COMMIT_PLACEHOLDER remains a template placeholder; no final B or trigger is reviewed here.

remaining_limits: No new Python parse, descriptor fault control, native invocation or workflow execution was performed by this review.
No lock is retained across all future path resolutions or child execution; a hostile concurrent same-UID mutation outside the fixed I/O observation is not claimed prevented.
The original A1 parent-chain OPEN and unexecuted status are preserved in their original review.
This review cannot promote the independently queued old Pretty run, the current source-closure CI, or retained historical ELF failures to PASS.
result: No concrete blocker found in the examined A2 delta. Final B workflow identity remains a separate readback.
